text:
Nora Patel: Kickoff for Ember Retail onboarding  start Mon 2026-05-11. Need final stakeholder roster, owners for infra/enablement/billing, and the 14-day success checklist. Any procurement/renewal flags? @Julian Park @Riley Morgan @Theo Alvarez

Julian Park: Intake shows stakeholders: Priya V. (Product), Marco G. (Infra), and S. Reed (Data). Finance contact pending. CSM noted a contract amendment review ~38 days out ":warning:"

Riley Morgan: I can run enablement (45 min). Will cover console walkthrough, rollout patterns, and common error triage. Will post a short agenda by EOD. Mornings preferred for Product.

Theo Alvarez: I'll own tech onboarding: env provisioning, API keys, sample dataset ingestion, and smoke tests. For Private deployment we need network owner's contact + approved IP ranges. I'll share a pre-checklist tomorrow.

Nora Patel: Proposed 14-day success metrics: 1) Staging end-to-end smoke with median gen latency <200ms; 2) 10 representative prompts meet quality gate (<=5% fail); 3) Console access for 3 engineers; 4) Billing estimate & quota sanity-check complete. Any additions?

Julian Park: Add: pin initial model to rw-v1.3 for stability and require data handling signoff if any prompt sets contain PII. Also track an "adoption signal": % calls routed from prod candidates by day 21.

Riley Morgan: I'll collect enablement feedback via a 3-question form and paste results into the playbook. Also will demo quick troubleshooting snippets.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: \"Ember - Enablement Workshop\" Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC  https://calendar.example/evt/99887

Theo Alvarez: Pre-onboard checklist (draft): - Create service account + API key - Provide IP allowlist entries - Upload sample payloads and schema - Grant console access for 3 engineers - Share test prompt set in shared drive

Quick sanity curl for devs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"Quick check","max_tokens":64}'
```

Nora Patel: Who will own the 14-day health summary (KPIs + blockers + renewal flags)? Need a one-pager and a 15-min readout on day 14.

Julian Park: I'll take the health summary. Draft will include p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, quality pass %, integration blockers, and renewal risk row. I'll share by day 12.

Riley Morgan: I'll synthesize enablement feedback and add notes to the playbook.

Nora Patel: I'll add the contract amendment review in 38 days to Renewal Signals as a medium risk and assign mitigation owners (exec intro, usage highlights, adoption checklist). Cadence: workshop Tue, quick go/no-go Fri.

Theo Alvarez: Shared drive folder created and checklist uploaded: https://drive.example/folder/ember-onboard. Added a contacts doc for firewall and network owners.

Julian Park: FYI infra asked for an SLA exceptions doc for initial throughput caps; will loop Marco and post values in the doc.
